[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] owned a '''dacha''' that was located near [[Lake Sah'ot]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] was recovering at the [[dacha]] from injuries sustained during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[siege of Caprioril]].
